model 2 for sleek-snowflake
python PatchTST_self_supervised/patchtst_pretrain.py \
  --dset_pretrain force \
  --context_points 80 \
  --target_points 96 \
  --batch_size 128 \
  --num_workers 4 \
  --scaler standard \
  --features M \
  --patch_len 16 \
  --stride 8 \
  --revin 1 \
  --n_layers 4 \
  --n_heads 16 \
  --d_model 256 \
  --d_ff 1024 \
  --dropout 0.2 \
  --head_dropout 0.2 \
  --mask_ratio 0.5 \
  --n_epochs_pretrain 100 \
  --lr 5e-5 \
  --pretrained_model_id 2 \
  --model_type based_model \
  --device cuda
